primary_meaning: Jesus Christ as the sacrificial Lamb of God whose death atones for the sins of the world

alternatives.meaning: Symbol of meekness, innocence, and purity
basis: general pastoral and sacrificial imagery in the Old Testament

alternatives.meaning: The triumphant, conquering Lamb who judges and reigns
basis: Revelation 5–22 (Lamb who opens the seals, receives worship, defeats enemies)

alternatives.meaning: Believers or disciples as vulnerable lambs needing protection

notes: The Christological identification of the Lamb as the atoning sacrifice is the overwhelmingly dominant and stable reading across historic Christian interpretation, drawing on Passover typology, Isaiah’s Servant, and New Testament fulfillment language. Other nuances remain secondary aspects of the same figure rather than competing primary symbols.
